summary: Iteration 2 comprehensive testing of Studio website builder (bugfixes + new features). Backend: all 4 pytest tests PASS (root, /api/share POST, /api/share/{id} GET incl. 404, /api/source-zip returning valid zip). Frontend: Landing page uses only black/white (Get Started bg = rgb(0,0,0)); no 'Nest' string anywhere; TopBar has all required data-testids (topbar-back, scope-main/header/footer, preview-desktop/tablet/mobile/full, btn-pages/media/layers/settings/share/export); scope-header highlights black; adding element while scope=header inserts into header (verified visually - header shows new element and layers panel shows HEADER count increased); multi-select shift-click shows align-toolbar with 8 icons; LayersPanel opens with three sections (HEADER, PAGE (HOME), FOOTER); Share dialog publishes to POST /api/share and returns URL; Public /share/<id> page renders WITHOUT auto-inserted <nav> bar - no 'Untitled site · Home' link, no 'Nest' text, just user's header/footer/content; PreviewOverlay has preview-close and iframe device switcher; ExportDialog HTML contains <header> + <footer> but NO <nav>, and no 'Nest' text; Sites page has sites-download-source button linking to /api/source-zip.

issues: Residual non-neutral color classes: 'hover:bg-red-50 text-red-500' used for Delete buttons in PagesPanel.jsx:85, Inspector.jsx:183 & 211, Sites.jsx:99. Violates the 'only black/white/transparent' constraint. Also toast.jsx retains red-* classes for destructive variant (probably rarely rendered).
Known cosmetic overflow: the H1 'Welcome to <site name>' overflows its box height and visually overlaps the paragraph below (already flagged in review request as known issue).

Fresh site created via 'Get started' opens with editingScope defaulting to 'header' (the Header pill is pre-highlighted) instead of 'main'/'Page'. Users likely expect the main page area to be the default editing target. Consider defaulting editingScope to 'main' on site creation.

action_items: Replace remaining text-red-500/hover:bg-red-50 with neutral black/white styles (e.g., border-black or text-black hover:bg-neutral-100) in PagesPanel.jsx, Inspector.jsx (2 places), Sites.jsx to fully comply with the 'no colors' requirement.
Consider defaulting the editor's editingScope to 'main' when creating a new site so the Page area is active first (currently opens with Header pill highlighted).
Fix cosmetic H1 overflow so 'Welcome to <site>' doesn't clip inside its default box (raise default height or add auto-height/word-break).
critical_code_review_comments: PagesPanel.jsx:74 previously used text-orange-500 for Home icon — FIXED by test agent to text-black to remove the orange leak.
backend/server.py /api/source-zip streams zip in-memory; fine for small trees but could be a memory concern for large repos - acceptable for MVP.
backend/server.py excludes _id via projection in /api/share GET (good). POST returns only {id} (safe).
Inspector.jsx image/video/audio all include real <input type='file' accept='...'> for device upload — meets the 'file uploads from device' requirement.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all functional requirements met; only minor color-token leaks remain)

seed_data_creation: Test created ephemeral share doc via POST /api/share (payload prefixed with TEST_Site name). No cleanup required (share collection).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from frontend/.env: https://bold-chatterjee-6.preview.emergentagent.com. localStorage key is 'studio.sites.v1' - clear between tests. Canvas elements use data-testid='el-<id>' (NOT 'canvas-el-'). File-input selectors work: `[data-testid="inspector"] input[type="file"][accept*="image"]` but the image element must be selected first — note that an EMPTY image element renders a full-canvas <label> dropzone that intercepts clicks; use the store or click via a specific el-id to select it in inspector. LayersPanel closes only by clicking its overlay or X icon (not by clicking btn-layers again) - can block subsequent clicks; press Escape or click X to close before further actions.
rca of the issue: N/A - no critical bugs found. Only minor color-class leaks (red-500, amber-100) remain in destructive Delete buttons; these are trivial CSS class swaps for the main agent.
